title: Compromised Employee Account - jdoe
root_cause: Root cause traced to: Login from unusual geolocation (Eastern Europe) outside business hours (ATT&CK stage: Initial Access).

timeline.description: Login from unusual geolocation (Eastern Europe) outside business hours
Obfuscated PowerShell command executed on WKS-102
Local admin group modified to include jdoe

recommended_action: Suspend the affected account and review privilege escalation paths on the host.
executive_summary: Multiple correlated alerts indicate a compromised employee account jdoe and endpoint WKS-102. The attack progressed through Initial Access -> Execution -> Privilege Escalation. Immediate account suspension is recommended pending investigation.
